description: Defines a class 'lower_phy_metrics_printer' that implements a metrics notifier for lower physical layer metrics, providing methods to process and print transmit and receive metrics, including power and clipping statistics.

classes.name: lower_phy_metrics_printer
classes.description: Implements a generic lower physical layer metrics printer, inheriting from lower_phy_metrics_notifier, with methods to handle new metrics and print summaries.

methods.name: on_new_transmit_metrics
methods.description: Handles new transmit metrics, updating power and clipping statistics with thread safety.

methods.name: on_new_receive_metrics
methods.description: Handles new receive metrics, updating power and clipping statistics with thread safety.

methods.name: print_header
methods.description: Prints the header for metrics display.

methods.name: print_metrics
methods.description: Calculates and prints current transmit and receive power and clipping statistics.
